embeds.title: WELCOME TO THE AFDF, {username}
embeds.description:
You can find our latest mod preset, which is what we'll use this Saturday, here: [LATEST MODPACK - TIMELINE A]({setting:modpack-url})

Now on to the tour.

fields.name: AFDF | Information
fields.value:
{channel:announcements_txt} is at the top. All Military Department announcements are made here, like deployment notices, promotions, or updates to our ORBAT (the ORBAT is in {channel:announcements_txt}).
{channel:information_db_txt} has info on our ranks and more, scroll up to find it.
{channel:events_txt} is where we post extra events at times, like our participation in the massive PVP event called OFCRA, or Laser's Vietnam campaign (info on the campaign is in {channel:vietnam_campaign_txt}).

fields.name: Documents
fields.value: Documents is where you find our TRADOCs, written almost exclusively by Laser. They are our SOP and some lore. Not required reading, but it is always nice to give it a look over if you have the time. I especially recommend 11-1, 11-2 and 11-3 for info on our Platoon and how we operate.

fields.name: Leave of Absence
fields.value: {channel:loa_txt} is where your LoAs go when you can't attend one of our Timeline A events. To post one, use the `/loa` command.

fields.name: General
fields.value: General is this chat. We usually try to keep it on topic of the unit, but as you can see, silliness creeps through even the tiniest crack. We have a DCS chat if that is something you do, otherwise the only thing left is the most underused VC on the server, barracks.
